plan.title: Drug x genotype 2x2 interaction DE in brain
plan.analytical_narrative: The question is whether the drug's effect on brain gene expression differs between knockout (KO) and wild-type (WT) animals. With a 2x2 factorial (genotype: WT/KO x treatment: vehicle/drug, 4 replicates per cell, 16 samples), the analysis of record is a DESeq2 model ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, testing the interaction coefficient (the difference of differences) and then reporting the simple drug effects within each genotype alongside it. Because the interaction contrast has a large standard error at 4 replicates per cell, power is limited and the report must state it. Steps: sample-structure QC on blind vst (PCA + distances to catch outliers/batch before any test), the DESeq2 Wald fit on the full ranked list with BH alpha 0.05, and a per-contrast fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark (second collection: WikiPathways human from the reference store) to translate the three contrasts (drug effect in WT, drug effect in KO, genotype-by-treatment interaction) into pathway-level hypotheses. Gene symbols feed the enrichment directly, so no cross-species identifier work is needed. Counts are already gene-level integers (summed from salmon), so no tximport is possible — there are no per-transcript quant files in the inputs; the plan proceeds on the gene-level matrix and notes that differential transcript usage cannot be assessed from it.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst blind PCA and sample distances
DESeq2 Wald test, design ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark
